stories.h: Community mod enables AMD FSR 4.1.2 on Intel Arc GPUs using XMX cores
stories.s: The OptiScaler project adapted FSR 4.1.2 Lite for Arc B580, achieving upscaling times of 0.59 ms, comparable to XeSS's 0.58 ms in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 tests.

stories.h: Tom's Hardware publishes weekly Premium roundup covering SSDs, AI models, tape storage growth and TP-Link US market plans
stories.s: The article summarizes new SSD type, Deepseek V4-Flash-1017 AI model, 57% YoY tape shipment rise, and TP-Link's $1 billion US R&D pledge and Mississippi assembly deal, among other topics.

stories.h: Footage shows RTX 5090 cards being dismantled in China for custom AI accelerators
stories.s: HKEPC video shows retail RTX 5090 GPUs stripped of dies and memory for use on accelerator boards, but the number of cards and legality remain unverified.

stories.h: ASUS releases preview driver adding AMD FSR 4.1 upscaling to ROG Xbox Ally handhelds
stories.s: The update, available via Armoury Crate SE, supports over 400 games, warns against using RSR simultaneously, and includes no performance figures yet.

stories.h: Bazzite Linux adds preliminary support for ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X20 and Acer Predator Atlas handhelds
stories.s: Developer Andy East announced full display and button support for the ASUS device and basic controller mapping for the Acer model, while noting missing RGB lighting, fan control and gyroscope features.

stories.h: Icy Dock launches ExpressSlot Elite MB303E5P-B PCIe 5.0 adapter for dual E1.S NVMe SSDs
stories.s: The adapter fits a single-slot PCIe x8 or x16 slot, provides two removable 9.5 mm E1.S caddies, and delivers up to 128 Gbps per SSD via independent PCIe x4 links, with active cooling and optional screw‑mount tray.

stories.h: MSI XpertStation WS300 workstation reviewed, featuring NVIDIA Grace CPU and Blackwell Ultra GPU
stories.s: The review details the WS300's 1.6kW power draw, 30kg weight, extensive liquid cooling, 1600W PSU, and dual 400Gbps networking, noting its $100K+ price tag and lack of USB4 ports.

stories.h: PCWorld lists top student laptops on Amazon, highlighting Acer Swift 16 AI and MacBook Neo
stories.s: The article recommends several models, noting the Acer Swift 16 AI’s 16‑inch OLED screen, Intel Ultra X7 358H CPU, 16 GB RAM and 17‑hour battery, and the MacBook Neo’s $689 price, A19 Pro chip and 8 GB memory.

stories.h: ASUS və Gigabyte RTX 5080 qiymətlərini Çində 2,000 yuanadək artırdı
stories.s: Topdan RTX 5080 16 GB qiymətləri indi 14,500‑15,000 yuan səviyyəsindədir, əvvəlki 12,700‑13,500 yuan səviyyəsindən, ASUS 1,000 yuan, Gigabyte isə 1,200 yuan əlavə edərək; RTX 5070 Ti də təxminən $100 artım gördü.
stories.he: ASUS and Gigabyte raise RTX 5080 prices in China by up to 2,000 yuan

stories.h: Razer Basilisk V4 Pro gaming mouse reviewed at $169.99
stories.s: Tom's Hardware notes the mouse adds AI prompt button, 12 programmable buttons, 200‑hour battery life, but finds the new buttons awkward and the price high.

stories.h: Gigabyte Z890M Aorus Elite WiFi7 Ice motherboard reviewed at $209
stories.s: Tom's Hardware finds the Micro ATX board offers solid specs, three M.2 slots and Wi‑Fi 7 but average performance and limited USB‑C ports, pricing it at $209 on Amazon.

stories.h: Corsair iCUE LINK TITAN II 360 RX LCD all-in-one AIO cooler reviewed at $239.99
stories.s: The review notes a 5-inch IPS display, three ARGB 120 mm fans with 400–2100 RPM, and a Flowdrive 2 pump, but questions performance versus price.

stories.h: Lava reports 32 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs found in China Telecom network
stories.s: The Israeli firm identified the export‑controlled chips using Nvidia's DCGM Exporter tool, despite U.S. bans, and Nvidia downplayed the findings without denying them.

stories.h: Asus ProArt P16 RTX Spark laptop launches at $7,000 with 128 GB unified memory and 16‑inch OLED display
stories.s: The review notes its thin 0.51‑inch chassis, 3.95 lb weight, RTX Spark chip with unified LPDDR5X memory, and premium features like six speakers and three 40 Gbps USB4 ports.

stories.h: AMD says dual 3D V-Cache benefits AI and broader workloads beyond gaming
stories.s: In an interview, AMD explains the cache can aid AI, content creation and multi‑core software, while confirming continued AM4 support and extended AM5 life where technically feasible.

stories.h: MINIX unveils EU738-AI ULTRA mini PC with integrated status screen for CPU, GPU and NPU activity
stories.s: The system uses an Intel Core Ultra X7 358H and Arc B390 graphics, claims up to 180 TOPS AI performance, and offers performance, balanced and silent modes, but pricing and full specs were not disclosed.

stories.h: MSI launches MEG EM9 open-air test bench with support for E-ATX and 420mm radiators
stories.s: The bench, priced at NT$2,590 in Taiwan with shipments due late October, offers removable PSU tray, adjustable radiator bracket and space for up to two 2.5" SSDs, targeting reviewers and system integrators.

stories.h: YMTC 9,600 MT/s tezlikdə işləyən LPDDR5X yaddaşının kütləvi istehsalına başlayacaq
stories.s: Counterpoint Research-ə görə, YMTC 16 Gb LPDDR5X yaddaşının 7,500 MT/s tezlikdə kiçik miqyaslı istehsalından Fab 3-də VCT 4F² hüceyrə texnologiyasından istifadə edərək 9,600 MT/s tezlikdə kütləvi istehsala keçir.
stories.he: YMTC will start mass production of LPDDR5X memory running at 9,600 MT/s

stories.h: Philips launches 36-inch Evnia gaming monitor with 240Hz native and 260Hz overclock
stories.s: The Evnia 36M4C5500P features a 1500R Fast VA panel, 3440×1440 resolution, DisplayHDR 400, 0.3ms MPRT response and will first launch in the APAC region, but pricing and wider availability are not yet disclosed.

stories.h: Micron 400-dən çox təbəqəli və bit sıxlığı təxminən ikiqat olan G11 3D NAND-ı elan etdi
stories.s: Micron rəsmilərinin bildirdiyinə görə, yeni G11 NAND 2027-ci ilin ikinci yarısında kütləvi istehsala daxil olacaq. Yeni məhsul interfeys sürətlərini 50%-ə qədər artırır və bit başına enerji sərfiyyatını 25%-dən çox azaldır.
stories.he: Micron announces G11 3D NAND with over 400 layers and roughly double bit density

stories.h: MSI launches MPG COREFROZR AP15 dual‑tower air cooler with integrated three‑channel temperature display
stories.s: The cooler, priced at 549 CNY (~$82) in China, features two 120 mm ARGB fans, six 6 mm copper heatpipes, and supports Intel LGA1700/LGA1851 and AMD AM4/AM5 sockets, but performance data has not been released yet.

stories.h: Getac launches B360X and B360X Pro rugged notebooks with Intel Core Ultra processors
stories.s: The new 14-inch devices feature AI‑boosted Intel Core Ultra 5/7/X7 CPUs, Wi‑Fi 7, optional 5G, dual hot‑swappable batteries and optional RTX PRO 500 graphics, and will ship in November 2026.

stories.h: GameSir launches G7 Pro 8K PC × Phantom Blade Zero Edition controller for $99.99
stories.s: The special edition, inspired by S‑GAME's Phantom Blade Zero, adds themed accessories and retains 8,000 Hz polling, 0.25 ms wired latency, and 1,200 mAh battery, with Amazon sales starting Oct 29.

stories.h: Two pallets of ZOTAC RTX 5090 GPUs worth about $470,000 disappeared from São Paulo airport
stories.s: Police say three airport workers moved the pallets on September 21 and one card later appeared online for R$32,000; the distributor Oderço confirmed the loss.

stories.h: Thermal Grizzly and CENS launch TG x CENS LN2 container for AMD and Nvidia GPUs at €599.90
stories.s: The modular liquid‑nitrogen cooling pot, co‑designed with overclocker Clemens “CENS” Nüssler, supports a range of Radeon 7900 series, 9070 cards and Nvidia GTX 1080 Ti up to RTX 5090, and includes Duronaut Pro paste.

stories.h: OverclockersUK and MSI launch OcUK Gaming Halo pre‑built PC with Ryzen 9 9950X3D and RTX 5090
stories.s: The flagship system features a 16‑core/32‑thread Ryzen 9 9950X3D up to 5.7 GHz, MSI GeForce RTX 5090 Suprim GPU, 96 GB DDR5‑6000 RAM and a 4 TB PCIe 5.0 SSD, sold exclusively via the UK retailer.

stories.h: Qotom Q51551UT mini-PC reviewed with 8 Ethernet ports including 2x10GbE and 6x2.5GbE
stories.s: ServeTheHome tested the Q51551UT, noting its Intel Core Ultra 5 125H CPU, 96 GB DDR5‑5600 RAM, and Intel Arc GPU, highlighting its networking focus and mixed USB ports.

stories.h: Xiaomi announces Redmi Book 14 2027 launch on Oct 27 with Intel Wildcat Lake CPU and 2.8K display
stories.s: The company revealed the October 27 release, confirming the device uses Intel Core 5 320 Wildcat Lake, a 72 Wh battery promising over 20 hours office use, LPDDR5X‑7467 RAM and a 2.8K screen, with a soft pink variant and fingerprint reader.

stories.h: FSP launches the MEGA PM 1200W 1200‑Watt ATX 3.1 power supply
stories.s: The unit features 80 Plus Platinum and Cybenetics Platinum efficiency, a 135 mm semi‑fanless FDB fan, industrial‑grade conformal coating and a 10‑year warranty, all in a 150 × 150 × 86 mm chassis.

stories.h: Corsair announces two Cyberpunk 2077 themed peripheral collections with CD Projekt Red
stories.s: The Arasaka White Collection and Edgerunners 2 Collection, featuring keyboards, mice, headsets and desk mats, go on pre‑order Oct 22, 2026 via Corsair.com and select retailers.

stories.h: Nvidia RTX 5090 shipment worth $470,000 stolen from Brazil airport, one card listed for $6,000 online
stories.s: Brazilian police say two outsourced forklift operators removed the pallets on Sep 21 and a third employee released them, with a Zotac RTX 5090 later posted on OLX showing its serial number.

stories.h: SAMA launches S32 WOOD microATX case bundled with 650 W or 850 W 80 Plus Gold PSU
stories.s: The bundles, priced at $139.99 for the 650 W and $159.99 for the 850 W version, support graphics cards up to 405 mm, CPU coolers up to 180 mm and are ATX 3.1‑ready, available on Amazon US and Newegg US.

stories.h: Thermaltake launches AI workstations A1500 Dual, A750, A550 and gaming PCs CAPO X Dual and View 380 XL
stories.s: The lineup features quad‑GPU RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell servers, RTX 5090 GPUs, up to 384 GB VRAM, 128 GB DDR5 ECC memory and 4 TB PCIe Gen 4 SSDs for enterprise AI, development and gaming workloads.

stories.h: EIZO launches FlexScan EV2401S 23.8-inch monitor with 120 Hz refresh and 7‑year warranty
stories.s: The new monitor consumes 9 W, offers 350 cd/m² brightness, 1500:1 contrast, USB‑C, and will ship in January 2027.

stories.h: LattePanda launches Sigma 2 single-board AI server with Intel Core Ultra X7 358H and up to 180 TOPS AI performance
stories.s: The Sigma 2 ships with up to 64 GB LPDDR5X RAM, dual 10 GbE, Thunderbolt 4 and a $2,599 pre‑sale price, targeting embedded AI appliances, robots and homelabs.

stories.h: TSMC seeks chipmaking equipment without Chinese rare‑earth magnets
stories.s: TSMC is approaching suppliers to source factory automation motors that avoid rare‑earth materials after China expanded export controls, aiming to reduce dependence on Chinese supply chains.

stories.h: AMD Ryzen 5 5500F reviewed with 8-10% performance gain over 5500 and PCIe 4.0 support
stories.s: Tom's Hardware notes the $120 street price, bundled Wraith Stealth cooler, and that it narrows the gap to Intel i3-14100F to 2.9% while offering 10% overall boost versus the base 5500.

stories.h: GALAX GeForce RTX 5080 Hall Of Fame Extreme kartını 400 W TGP və cüt 12V‑2x6 konnektorlarla təqdim etdi
stories.s: Kart 20 fazalı GPU güc təchizatı, 4 fazalı GDDR7 yaddaş və OC rejimində 2,805 MHz boost saat tezliyi ilə təchiz olunub. Çində qiyməti 19,999 yuan (~2,995 ABŞ dolları) təşkil edir.
stories.he: GALAX unveils GeForce RTX 5080 Hall Of Fame Extreme with 400 W TGP and dual 12V‑2x6 connectors

stories.h: Micron abandons 4F² DRAM development after two decades of research
stories.s: Micron's president and chief technology and products officer Scott DeBoer said the 4F² architecture offers no density advantage and adds cost, so the company will focus on scaling conventional 6F² DRAM and 3D DRAM instead.

stories.h: Best Buy cuts $950 off Alienware 16X Aurora laptop to $1,949.99
stories.s: The RTX 5070‑powered Alienware 16X Aurora with a Core Ultra 9 290HX CPU, 16 GB DDR5‑5600 RAM and 1 TB SSD now costs $1,949.99, down from $2,899.99, per Tom's Hardware.

stories.h: TrendForce projects server CPU shipments to grow over 40% YoY in 2027
stories.s: The forecast cites rising AI inference demand and expanding Arm‑based CPU share, with Arm expected to capture about 30% of the market by 2027, up from just over 10% in 2025.

stories.h: Formula V Line Air Power G10 case reviewed with pivoting front fans for $99.99
stories.s: KitGuru finds the novel front panel adds style but offers no significant cooling benefit, noting thin steel panels and fiddly screws, while pricing the case just under $100.

stories.h: Several Linux kernel vulnerabilities were accidentally posted publicly
stories.s: The reports appeared on the public kernel mailing list instead of the private security list, with CVSS scores up to 9.0 and patches still pending in mainline and -next branches.

stories.h: Linux 7.4 kernel adds AMD Zen 6 security mitigation adjustments
stories.s: The merged x86/bugs pull request updates CPU security mitigations for AMD Zen 6 processors and adds power management support for Zen 6 and Intel Rugged Panther Lake in Linux 7.4.

stories.h: AMD revives Ryzen 7 5800X3D for AM4 as an anniversary edition
stories.s: The CPU, identical to the original specs, was released after CEO Lisa Su approved manufacturing updates with TSMC, aiming to aid DDR4 users transitioning to AM5 and DDR5.

stories.h: NVIDIA DGX Spark can now be linked into eight-node clusters with up to 1TB unified memory
stories.s: The eight-system setup totals 1TB using 128GB per unit and connects via built‑in ConnectX‑7 networking, with a 64GB version rolling out to partners on 23 October.

stories.h: MSI announced the Raider 16 HX B2W laptop in Japan with an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX CPU and RTX 5070 Ti GPU
stories.s: The 16‑inch gaming notebook features a 2560×1600 240 Hz display, 32 GB RAM, 1 TB SSD, 91.8 Wh battery and weighs 2.45 kg, with pricing not disclosed at launch.

stories.h: Super Flower launches VGA 12+4PIN OCP Dongle for GPU 12V-2x6 connectors
stories.s: The inline dongle monitors per‑line current, alerts at 9.5‑12 A or 6 A imbalance, and triggers a red LED and screen blackout above 12 A; priced at NT$1,190 (~$38) in Taiwan as a bundle with Leadex VIII PSUs.

stories.h: Linus Torvalds removes unsafe __get_user() and __put_user() functions in Linux 7.4
stories.s: The change, merged on 2026-10-21, was aided by AI Claude Code and eliminates historically unsafe kernel APIs.

stories.h: TechPowerUp publishes a review of the ASRock Z890 Taichi Aqua motherboard
stories.s: The review details specifications such as support for Intel Core Ultra Series 2 CPUs, up to DDR5‑9600 memory, dual 10 Gbps Ethernet, Wi‑Fi 7, and multiple PCIe Gen 5 slots, but no pricing or availability information is provided.

stories.h: NVIDIA partners with major manufacturers to triple substrate capacity by 2028
stories.s: The plan adds 2.5x substrate capacity, over 300% interposer wafer capacity and 15x optical engine capacity, with build‑outs slated through 2028 across partners in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore and the U.S.

stories.h: MSI Cyborg A15 gaming laptop with RTX 5060 launches at $1,249
stories.s: The laptop features an eight‑core AMD Ryzen 7 260 CPU, 16 GB DDR5, 1 TB SSD and a 144 Hz IPS display, but has a 55 Wh battery and a single M.2 slot.

stories.h: Nvidia's GeForce 621.01 driver adds support for Microsoft's Advanced Shader Delivery
stories.s: The driver enables cloud‑precompiled shaders for supported games like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Gears of War: E‑Day, aiming to eliminate shader‑compilation stutters on PC.

stories.h: 4TB Samsung 990 Pro SSD price drops 27% to $799.90, about 20¢/GB
stories.s: The drive fell from $1,099 to $799.90, offering the same 7,450/6,900 MB/s speeds and 2,400 TBW endurance after a steep discount amid rising storage costs.

stories.h: ASML and other key semiconductor equipment suppliers are expediting shipments to Elon Musk's Terafab project
stories.s: Musk announced during SpaceX's Q3 2026 earnings call that accelerated deliveries aim to support chip volume production in Texas by Q3‑Q4 2028, with Intel's 14A node and a 440,000‑GPU Nvidia cluster planned for 2027.

stories.h: PHP releases patches for two critical vulnerabilities rated 9.2 severity
stories.s: The flaws affect versions from 5.4 onward, with patches for PHP 8.2‑8.5, prompting operators to shut down sites temporarily while updating.

stories.h: Acer Japan launches 31.5‑inch 6K and 27‑inch 5K ProDesigner pen‑enabled monitors
stories.s: The PE320QXTbmiiphcuzx and PE270XTbmiiphcuzx are priced at ¥156,800 (~US$992) and ¥125,800 (~US$796) and feature 10‑point touch, 4,096‑level pen pressure, 99% Adobe RGB/DCI‑P3 coverage and USB‑C with up to 90 W PD.

stories.h: AMD product director explains why Ryzen 3 desktop CPUs are limited
stories.s: Travis Kirsch said AMD prefers using mobile‑derived APUs for low‑cost desktops due to cheaper single‑die design versus multi‑chiplet CCDs, but gave no new product details.

stories.h: Keychron launches J3 SE 96% wireless mechanical keyboard at US$129.99
stories.s: The 99‑key board features a FR4 plate, hot‑swappable Sakura Milk linear switches, 4,000 mAh battery claimed for up to 200 hours wireless use, and wired USB‑C and 2.4 GHz connectivity at 1 kHz polling.

stories.h: Thermaltake launches View 590 TG ARGB mid‑tower chassis with curved tempered glass and five pre‑installed fans
stories.s: The new case supports Mini‑ITX to SSI‑CEB boards, graphics cards up to 435 mm, and up to eleven 120 mm fans or a 360 mm radiator, and includes USB‑C, USB‑3.0 and HD Audio ports.

stories.h: Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme benchmarked on Linux in ASUS Zenbook A16
stories.s: Phoronix ran initial Linux benchmarks using Ubuntu 26.10 X1E Concept ISO, showing the SoC's performance exceeds expectations.

stories.h: Chieftec launches two compact CPU coolers, the CAC‑S90PWM‑T120 and CAC‑S92PWM‑LP45
stories.s: The tower cooler measures 80 × 92 × 117 mm with a 90 mm PWM fan, while the low‑profile model is 110.8 × 93 × 45 mm and uses a 92 mm PWM fan; both support Intel and AMD CPUs and come with a 24‑month warranty, but pricing and availability were not disclosed.

stories.h: FADU unveils File‑Semantic SSD that embeds a filesystem in the drive
stories.s: The FS‑SSD uses an FC6161 Gen6 controller in PCIe 5.0, claims up to 460,000 NFSv3 ops/s with a single CPU core and shows mixed performance versus Ext4 and F2FS in synthetic tests, with partner samples expected Q3 2027.

stories.h: AMD releases Linux kernel patches for Ryzen overclocking driver (AOD)
stories.s: The patches add an AMD Overclocking driver (AOD) to the kernel, giving Linux users a native way to overclock Ryzen CPUs similar to Windows' Ryzen Master.

stories.h: NVIDIA releases GeForce 621.01 WHQL driver fixing black flashes and FPS drops on 360 Hz monitors
stories.s: The driver also resolves freezing in Meta Horizon Link USB streams and intermittent dimming on some ASUS notebooks, and adds Game Ready support for new titles like Phantom Blade Zero and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

stories.h: Micron-un Tayvan sindikası 22 oktyabrda bir günlük strejk keçirməyi planlaşdırır, yaddaş istehsalına təsir edə bilər
stories.s: Micron-un Taoyuan zavodundakı strejk daha yaxşı bonuslar və mənfəətin bölüşdürülməsini tələb edir. Bir günlük iş dayanması istehsalı bir qədər azalsa da, bu, rekord DDR5 və HBM tələbatı fonunda baş verir.
stories.he: Micron's Taiwan union plans one-day strike on Oct 22, could affect memory output

stories.h: MSI releases Stealth 16 AI+ laptop with Intel Core Ultra 9 386H and RTX 5070
stories.s: The reviewed unit ships with 16 GB RAM, a 2560×1600 OLED display, and a cooling system praised for quiet operation, while a US configuration offers 32 GB RAM at $2,299.99.

stories.h: Dynamic PAMT added to Linux 7.4 to reduce memory overhead on Intel TDX servers
stories.s: The new feature aims to lower RAM usage on Intel Xeon servers running TDX, addressing high memory prices and limited availability, according to Phoronix.

stories.h: AOC unveils CU34G4ZD ultrawide 5th‑gen QD‑OLED monitor with 280 Hz refresh
stories.s: The 34‑inch curved display features a 1800R panel, 0.03 ms response, 300 nits typical brightness up to 1300 nits HDR, and VESA DisplayHDR True Black 500 certification, plus HDMI 2.1, DP 1.4 and FreeSync support.

stories.h: Cooler Master releases HAF II 500 full‑tower case with up to 310 mm motherboard support
stories.s: The case features steel, plastic and tempered glass construction, 8 expansion slots, multiple fan mounts including two pre‑installed 220 mm Mighty40 fans, and supports up to three 3.5" and six 2.5" drives.

stories.h: TP-Link proposes $1 billion U.S. router manufacturing alliance with Key Tronic
stories.s: The plan aims to assemble routers in the United States to address FCC bans, after the company faced lawsuits and accusations of Chinese ties, while competitors like Amazon, Asus and Netgear have secured conditional approvals.

stories.h: Corsair adds PureVector tech to Sabre V3 Pro mouse line with three new material versions
stories.s: The updated lineup includes ergonomic and symmetrical models in ABS, carbon fiber and magnesium, priced from $179.99 to $229.99, featuring 42,000 DPI sensor and up to 200‑hour battery life.

stories.h: AMD and Microsoft confirm FSR 4.1 upscaling will arrive on Xbox Series X|S and ROG Xbox Ally handheld
stories.s: The announcement was made in an AMD video with Jack Huynh, Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet and ASUS, but no release date or game list was provided, and the handheld support may require an ASUS driver update.

stories.h: AMD releases Adrenalin 26.10.1 WHQL drivers adding FSR 4.1 support for Radeon RX 6000 series and Ryzen AI processors
stories.s: The update also adds game support for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, STAR WARS: Galactic Racer and FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, and fixes a stuttering issue in Modern Warfare 4 on RX 6000 cards.

stories.h: ID-Cooling opens pre‑orders for FLOW 500 micro‑ATX case at CNY 269–389
stories.s: The new case features a front‑mounted PSU and an optional birch‑style wood grille, with pricing converting to about $40–$58, but international availability has not been announced.

stories.h: iiyama lists new 34-inch UWQHD business monitor with integrated webcam and USB‑C docking
stories.s: The ProLite XCB3492WQSNPH‑B1 features a 3,440×1,440 IPS panel at 100 Hz, 5 MP webcam, up to 95 W Power Delivery and KVM switch, but price and launch date are not yet announced.

stories.h: Broadcom marşrutizatorlarındakı WPSplinter zəifliyi milyonlarla cihazı təsirə məruz qoyur, həll yolu yoxdur
stories.s: Təhlükəsizlik tədqiqatçısı Quentin Kaiser bildirir ki, Broadcom-un Wi-Fi Protected Setup xüsusiyyətindəki 16 illik WPSplinter zəifliyi hücumçulara uzaqdan kod enjeksiyası etməyə imkan verir və 2018-ci ildə qismən tətbiq edilmiş yamağa baxmayaraq, istehsalçılar tam həll yolu təqdim etməyiblər.
stories.he: WPSplinter vulnerability in Broadcom routers affects millions with no fix

stories.h: Dell warns memory shortages could worsen in 2027
stories.s: CEO Michael Dell says DRAM and HBM supply may tighten as AI data‑centre builds continue, with some new fabs not fully operational until 2029‑2030, potentially affecting server and PC builder plans.

stories.h: Intel Core Ultra 9 285H laptop shows performance gains on Ubuntu 26.10 versus 26.04
stories.s: Phoronix benchmarks the Star Labs StarFighter Ultra with the Intel Core Ultra 9 285H and finds higher scores across dozens of tests on Ubuntu 26.10 compared to the 26.04 LTS release.

stories.h: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra reviewed at $2,599 base price with RTX Spark GPU
stories.s: The review notes average single‑core CPU performance, strong graphics, 10‑hour battery life, and app compatibility issues on Windows on Arm, with prices ranging to $5,899.99.

stories.h: QNAP launches USB4 JBOD series with 8‑bay desktop and 12‑bay rackmount models
stories.s: The TL-D810TC4 desktop offers up to 8 bays and the TL-R1210TC4‑RP rackmount provides 12 bays, both delivering up to 40 Gbps via USB4 and supporting SATA 6 Gb/s drives, with availability starting now.

stories.h: Corsair Sabre V3 Pro PureVector mouse reviewed at £210 with 48g weight
stories.s: KitGuru notes the mouse’s lightweight design and web driver configuration but finds the PureVector software’s claimed 33% aim boost unproven and the high price steep.

stories.h: Corsair launches RM1200e 1200W Platinum PSU with PinProtect per‑pin OCP
stories.s: The new RM1200e offers 91% efficiency, Intel ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 certification, a 3D Y‑fan grille, modular Japanese 105 °C capacitors and a 10‑year warranty, and is available in black and white.

stories.h: Axiomtek launches MANO330 compact Thin Mini‑ITX industrial motherboard with Intel N97/N150 and DDR5‑4800 support
stories.s: The board measures 170 × 170 mm, supports up to 32 GB RAM with N97, offers dual LAN, multiple display outputs and versatile M.2 slots, and is now available for industrial automation and digital signage applications.

stories.h: Nvidia's Vera CPUs win design deal with AI cloud provider Modal, showing double throughput vs AMD and Intel
stories.s: Modal reported Vera delivered twice the throughput of its current AMD and Intel CPUs, and Nvidia expects at least $20 billion in Vera sales this fiscal year, targeting a $200 billion market.

stories.h: Philips launches 27‑inch and 31.5‑inch QHD curved monitors priced at £129.99 and £169.99
stories.s: The 27E3C2500 and 32E3C2500 feature 144 Hz refresh, 0.5 ms MPRT, HDR10, Adaptive‑Sync and built‑in speakers, and will be available in November.

stories.h: Electronics hobbyist converts $120 DDR5 SODIMM kit into a $1000 desktop kit
stories.s: Blighted Agent repurposed a SK hynix 2x16 GB DDR5‑5600 SODIMM bought for $120 into 2x16 GB DDR5‑7800 desktop modules using custom PCBs and re‑balling, costing $175 total and achieving DDR5‑7800 CL38 at 1.40 V.

stories.h: ASUS ProArt P14 reviewed with NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X 128GB unified memory
stories.s: Guru3D tests the new RTX Spark platform featuring an Arm CPU, Blackwell GPU and 128 GB LPDDR unified memory in the 14‑inch creator laptop, noting AI and creative workflow benefits and software compatibility considerations.

stories.h: GMKtec NucBox M6 Ultra adds a Ryzen 5 7640HS model priced at ¥109,800 ($694)
stories.s: The new configuration reduces memory to 16 GB and storage to 512 GB SSD, retains dual 2.5 GbE ports and USB4, and will be available in late October 2026 in Japan.

stories.h: GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB-nin Yaponiyadakı qiyməti ¥137,800-ə çatıb, 30 gündə 26,45% artıb
stories.s: Qiymət artımı yaddaş çatışmazlığı və GDDR7-nin yüksək xərcləri ilə əlaqələndirilir. Kartın qiyməti indi $429-lik başlanğıc MSRP-dən təxminən 70% yüksəkdir və daha yüksək sinif GPU-larla eyni səviyyədədir.
stories.he: GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB price in Japan hits ¥137,800, up 26.45% in 30 days

stories.h: ASUS ROG Astral RTX 5090 listed for about $12,000 on Chinese gray market
stories.s: The price is roughly $12,000 (HK$93,600/NT$384,000), far above the $7,000–$9,600 range seen elsewhere, reflecting US export restrictions and limited supply.

stories.h: Cooler Master launches Elite 450 compact Micro-ATX case under 30 L
stories.s: The case features two 160 mm ARGB front fans, a 120 mm ARGB rear fan, supports GPUs up to 317 mm and CPU coolers up to 163 mm, and includes USB‑A, USB‑C and audio ports on the front panel.

stories.h: Der8auer’s two‑year study shows Conductonaut Extreme forms a stable CuGa2 layer on copper cold plates
stories.s: The analysis found the alloy grows about 1 µm per day to 50‑100 µm, stabilising after two months and improving thermal conductivity versus raw copper.

stories.h: AMD Ryzen AI Halo Mini-PC with 128 GB LPDDR5X memory reviewed
stories.s: The review notes the 16‑core Zen 5 APU, Radeon 8060S GPU and $4,000 price, highlighting its ability to run large AI models locally versus a RTX 5090’s 32 GB VRAM.

stories.h: Intel opens pull request to add XMX‑accelerated XeSS support to Valve's Proton
stories.s: The changes also modify VKD3D‑Proton and DXVK, enabling XeSS upscaling for Linux games via Steam Play.

stories.h: PCWorld lists three top USB‑C monitors for 2026, highlighting Dell Ultrasharp U3225QE
stories.s: The guide recommends Dell Ultrasharp U3225QE as the overall best, BenQ GW2786TC as the budget pick and ViewSonic VP16‑OLED as the portable option, detailing their specs and connectivity features.

stories.h: Chinese hacker used AI agents to breach over 100 company websites
stories.s: Researcher Snorre Fagerland of NorForge observed the hacker exploiting exposed Carin AI instances to target firms in the US, Canada, Australia and Japan, attempting attacks on more than 1,200 sites by Oct 18, 2026.

stories.h: Windows Secure Boot certificates expired in June 2026, new updates required
stories.s: PCWorld explains that certificates dating back to 2011 expired in June 2026 and users must ensure firmware or Windows updates have applied the new certificates to keep Secure Boot active.

stories.h: ASUS launches Zenbook 14 (UX3480) with Arctic Blue and Komodo Coral finishes in Europe
stories.s: The new premium laptop features Ceraluminum material and AI‑powered experiences, with brand‑experience events held in cities such as London, Milan, Madrid and others.

stories.h: HP Omnibook Ultra 16 with 20‑core RTX Spark starts at $3,200
stories.s: The base model includes 32 GB RAM and pre‑installed McAfee, while higher‑end configurations can exceed $6,000 with up to 128 GB RAM, and the laptop forces ads in Windows 11 solitaire.

stories.h: Creality Pika portable 3D scanner launches on pre‑order for $699
stories.s: The handheld scanner, weighing 260 g, offers blue‑laser and NIR modes, Wi‑Fi connectivity and runs on AA‑size rechargeable batteries; it ships July 22 2026 and requires a PC with i7‑Gen7 CPU and 16 GB RAM for optimal use.

stories.h: Anthropic warns AI‑driven malware could infect smart ovens and other IoT devices
stories.s: The research showed small AI models can self‑replicate across vulnerable Android TV boxes in a lab, suggesting similar attacks on smart appliances could appear within months.

stories.h: SpacemiT announced the V100 server-class RISC-V processor
stories.s: The V100 follows the K3 RVA23 SoC and targets data‑center workloads, according to the company's announcement on 2026‑10‑19.

stories.h: HP Googlebook 14 reviewed at $1,199.99 with premium OLED display
stories.s: PCWorld notes its aluminum build, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB SSD and Snapdragon X Elite CPU, but criticizes the high price and limited ports.

stories.h: Arm bildirir ki, AGI prosessoru AMD EPYC 9755-ə nisbətən rək üzrə 2 dəfəyə qədər yüksək performans göstərir
stories.s: Arm-ın müstəqil təhlili göstərir ki, AGI prosessoru yeddi iş yükündən beşində EPYC 9755-i üstələyir, fastText-də 97%-ə qədər sürətli işləyir və çip üzrə 20% orta üstünlük təşkil edir – bu, Arm-ın yeni qiymətləndirmə metodologiyasına əsaslanır.
stories.he: Arm says its AGI CPU delivers up to 2× the performance per rack of AMD EPYC 9755

stories.h: ORICO launches Obook 15 AI laptop with AMD Ryzen 7 6800H starting at $689.99
stories.s: The 15.6" IPS notebook offers 12 GB or 24 GB of 6,400 MT/s RAM, up to 1 TB SSD, 54.29 Wh battery and a bundled 100 W charger, and is available in the US and the Philippines.

stories.h: ASUS adds ROG Strix XG27ACMSR monitor with QHD 360Hz, Full HD 420Hz and HD 640Hz modes
stories.s: The 27‑inch display targets competitive gamers, offering three refresh‑rate modes to balance image quality and GPU load, though scaling quality may vary.

stories.h: AOC U27G4Z monitor supports 4K 240Hz and Full HD 480Hz via DisplayPort 2.1
stories.s: The dual‑mode panel requires a high‑end GPU and may need Display Stream Compression, while HDMI 2.1 offers an alternative for high refresh rates.

stories.h: Philips launches Evnia 34M2C5601QA ultrawide 34" 200Hz monitor priced at £299
stories.s: The monitor features a 1500R Fast VA panel, 3440×1440 resolution, 350‑500 nits brightness, 4,000:1 contrast, USB‑C with 90W PD, HDMI, DisplayPort and speakers.

stories.h: AOC unveils 27-inch AGP277QKM gaming monitor with 425 Hz QHD refresh and 1,000‑nit QD Mini‑LED HDR
stories.s: The Chinese‑made display uses a Fast IPS panel, local dimming and Quantum‑dot Mini‑LED backlight, but price and global release date remain unannounced.

stories.h: GL.iNet launches Comet Q GL-RMQ1 remote KVM with single USB‑C cable
stories.s: The Comet Q GL‑RMQ1 is a remote KVM device that uses a single USB‑C cable for power, video, and peripheral control, featuring a 1.8″ touchscreen and Wi‑Fi connectivity.

stories.h: Developer releases VBIOS configurator for RTX 30‑50 series GPUs without flashing
stories.s: Panchovix's tools let users modify power, voltage and clock limits via driver registry overrides on Windows and kernel patches on Linux, avoiding flash‑chip risks and supporting RTX 30‑50 cards.

stories.h: DLSS-NR mod adds full DLSS 5 suite to AMD Radeon 6000-9000 series GPUs
stories.s: The 0.8.0 update brings DLSS SR, Frame Generation, Ray Regeneration and Neural Rendering to RX 6000, 7000 and 9000 cards via the NeuralHub loader, though performance varies and anti‑cheat is unsupported.

stories.h: Luumi sets new HWBot Cinebench R11.5 record with Intel Core i5-4670K at 10.8 cb
stories.s: Overclocker Luumi achieved a 10.8 cb multicore score on a liquid‑nitrogen cooled Intel Core i5‑4670K, breaking a 12‑year HWBot record for that CPU category.

stories.h: NVIDIA 10 Cortex-X925 nüvəli və 48 SM Blackwell GPU-lu RTX Spark N1X ARM SoC-ni təqdim edir
stories.s: NVIDIA şirkətinin ilk istifadəçilərə yönəlmiş ARM SoC-si olan RTX Spark N1X-i təqdim etdi. Cihazda 10 Cortex-X925 və 10 Cortex-A725 nüvəli MediaTek CPU çipi, 16 kanallı LPDDR5X magistralı və 6144 CUDA nüvəli 48 SM Blackwell GPU var.
stories.he: NVIDIA launches RTX Spark N1X ARM SoC with 10 Cortex‑X925 cores and 48‑SM Blackwell GPU

stories.h: San-Paulu hava limanında dəyəri 470 000 dollar olan Zotac RTX 5090 partiyası itkin düşüb
stories.s: Braziliya distribyutoru Oderço bildirir ki, Qaruluş Beynəlxalq Hava Limanına çatdıqdan sonra təxminən 470 000 dollar (2 500 000 real) dəyərində iki pallet Zotac RTX 5090 qrafik prosessoru (GPU) itkin düşüb.
stories.he: Zotac RTX 5090 shipment worth $470,000 missing at São Paulo airport

stories.h: Intel 480GB-ə qədər LPDDR5X yaddaşlı GPU D-Seriya akseleratorunu təqdim etdi
stories.s: Intel süni intellekt üçün D-Seriya GPU akseleratorunu təqdim etdi. Cihaz 1.3 PFLOPS FP8-ə qədər performans, 1.5TB/s zolaq eni, 480GB LPDDR5X yaddaş və 350W PCIe form-faktorunu təklif edir; hər sistemdə səkkiz karta qədər dəstəklənir.
stories.he: Intel launches GPU D-Series accelerator with up to 480GB LPDDR5X memory

stories.h: ASUS ilk Intel Arc GPU-sunu — 32 GB UGen Arc Pro B70-i — saytına əlavə edib
stories.s: ASUS 32 GB UGen Arc Pro B70-i saytına əlavə edərək ilk Intel Arc kartını təqdim edib. Kartda 32 Xe2 nüvə, 256 XMX mühərriki, 2,800 MHz boost tezliyi və 290 W TDP var.
stories.he: ASUS lists its first Intel Arc GPU, the 32 GB UGen Arc Pro B70

stories.h: Intel 700 TOPS AI hesablamasına malik Razor Lake-AX platformasını təqdim etdi
stories.s: Intel-in senior vitse-prezidenti Cho Min-sung 700 TOPS AI hesablaması təmin edən Razor Lake-AX platformasını təqdim edib. Panther Lake-dən 3.88 dəfəyə qədər sürətli olan platformada 16 və ya 32 nüvəli Xe3 iGPU və paket üzərində LPDDR5X/LPDDR6 yaddaş tətbiq olunub. Platformanın 2028-ci ildə buraxılması planlaşdırılır.
stories.he: Intel unveils Razor Lake-AX with 700 TOPS AI compute

stories.h: Nvidianın senior vitse-prezidenti: RTX 5090-un istehsalı təchizatın məhdud olmasına baxmayaraq dayandırılmayıb
stories.s: Nvidianın senior vitse-prezidenti Jeff Fisher Tayvan mətbuatına RTX 5090-un istehsalının davam etdiyini, lakin təchizatın məhdud olduğunu və kartların $1,999-luq MSRP-dən xeyli yüksək qiymətə satıldığını bildirib.
stories.he: Nvidia senior VP says RTX 5090 not discontinued despite tight supply

stories.h: Nvidia RTX Spark laptops and Surface Ultra now on sale with up to 128GB unified memory
stories.s: Nvidia's RTX Spark SoC is now generally available, with laptops from Asus, Lenovo, HP, Dell and Microsoft offering configurations from 24GB to 128GB memory and prices up to $7,000.

stories.h: Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5 32GB kit price cut by $108 to $409
stories.s: Corsair reduced the price of its 32GB (2x16GB) DDR5‑5600 Vengeance RGB kit by $108, now selling for $409 directly from the maker.

stories.h: Sipeed MaixStation AI server announced with 128GB LPDDR5X, 256‑bit bus, $3,999 price
stories.s: Sipeed unveiled the MaixStation, built on Axera AX8860P (16‑core Cortex‑A55, 256 TOPS NPU) with 128 GB LPDDR5X at 273 GB/s, slated for a $3,999 Kickstarter launch later 2026.

stories.h: MSI unveils limited-edition RTX 5080 COD MW4 with 200 units for Europe
stories.s: MSI announced a special RTX 5080 COD Modern Warfare 4 edition, featuring yellow accents and custom backplate, limited to 200 units in Europe.

stories.h: Refurbished Dell Latitude 5420 sells for $264.99, down from $1,099 MSRP
stories.s: A grade‑A refurbished Dell Latitude 5420 with an 11th Gen i5, 8 GB RAM and 256 GB SSD is listed at $264.99, far below its $1,099 MSRP, with limited inventory.

stories.h: PCWorld lists best laptops under $500
stories.s: PCWorld reviews budget laptops, recommending specs like 8GB RAM, 1080p display, and SSD, and highlights models such as the MacBook Neo and Asus Chromebooks.

stories.h: Microsoft releases KB5127648 to fix Windows 11 black screen after sign‑in
stories.s: Microsoft's KB5127648 update for Windows 11 24H2, 25H2 and 26H2 resolves a black‑screen issue in multi‑user environments like Azure Virtual Desktop and improves Bluetooth reliability and gaming mouse stutter.

stories.h: PCWorld lists top ultrawide monitors for 2026, highlighting MSI MPG 341CQR and Dell U4025QW
stories.s: PCWorld's 2026 guide reviews several ultrawide monitors, naming MSI MPG 341CQR as the best overall and Dell U4025QW as the top 5K option, with details on specs, pros, and cons.

stories.h: PCWorld releases 2026 laptop roundup featuring Acer Aspire 16 AI and MacBook Neo
stories.s: PCWorld's October 2026 roundup reviews over 70 laptops, highlighting the Acer Aspire 16 AI as best overall and the MacBook Neo as the best budget model.

stories.h: Intel Xeon 6980P server performance on Ubuntu 26.10 vs 25.10
stories.s: Phoronix benchmarks the Gigabyte R284-A92-AAL1 server with dual Xeon 6980P CPUs, 24 × Micron MRDIMM‑8800 RAM and a 1.5TB KIOXIA SSD, comparing Ubuntu 26.10 to last year’s Ubuntu 25.10.

stories.h: Star Labs StarFighter Ultra laptop benchmarked at LPDDR5-5467, 6400 and 7467 MT/s
stories.s: Phoronix tested the Star Labs StarFighter Ultra with Intel Core Ultra 9 285H, measuring performance and power at three LPDDR5 speeds: 5467, 6400 and 7467 MT/s.

stories.h: Memtest86+ 9.0 released with ARM64 support and DDR5 bus stress test
stories.s: Memtest86+ version 9.0 adds ARM64 testing for Raspberry Pi 4/5 and Snapdragon X laptops, new SIMD tests, DDR5 bus stress and RowHammer tests, plus support for Intel Core 3 Wildcat Lake CPUs.

stories.h: 3mdeb releases Dasharo 0.9 firmware for ASRock Rack SPC741D8 adding Emerald Rapids support
stories.s: Dasharo 0.9 for the ASRock Rack SPC741D8-2L2T now supports Intel Emerald Rapids CPUs, enables Intel TXT, adds SMI Transfer Monitor, PCIe bifurcation, and fixes boot, TPM and Secure Boot bugs, plus includes an embedded SBoM.

stories.h: Modder adds quad 8‑pin connectors to RTX 5090, halving wire current
stories.s: A Reddit modder created a conversion board that mounts four 8‑pin PCIe connectors on an RTX 5090, reducing per‑wire current to about 4.1‑4.4 A at 600 W and lowering temperatures by ~20 °C.

stories.h: Der8auer tests Thermal Grizzly Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal over two years
stories.s: Der8auer's two‑year study shows the TIM forms a CuGa2 layer growing ~1 µm/day up to 50‑100 µm, stabilizing after ~2 months, with thermal conductivity around 100 W/m·K.

stories.h: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090-ı rəsmi satış platformasından çıxarır, GB202 təyinatını dayandırır
stories.s: NVIDIA-nın rəsmi satış platformasında GeForce RTX 5090 artıq siyahıya alınmır və onun üçün GB202 çip təyinatı dayandırılıb. Bu, Avropada və ABŞ-da təchizatın tükənməsinə və qiymətlərin kəskin artmasına səbəb olub.
stories.he: NVIDIA removes GeForce RTX 5090 from official marketplace, halts GB202 allocation

stories.h: NVIDIA launches RTX Spark laptops with up to 128 GB unified memory and 1 PFLOP AI performance
stories.s: NVIDIA announced RTX Spark laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, featuring a Blackwell RTX GPU, Grace CPU, up to 128 GB unified memory and 1 PFLOP FP4 AI performance for local AI workloads.

stories.h: ASUS launches ProArt P16 and P14 laptops with NVIDIA RTX Spark in Canada
stories.s: ASUS announced the ProArt P16 and P14 creator laptops, featuring NVIDIA RTX Spark (Blackwell RTX GPU, Grace CPU, up to 128 GB unified memory) and now available for purchase in Canada through major retailers.

stories.h: Team Group T-CREATE EXPERT Ai DDR5 128 GB module wins Good Design Award 2026
stories.s: Team Group announced its 128 GB per module DDR5 CQDIMM, rated 8,000 MT/s at 1.1 V, has won the Good Design Award 2026 for its creator‑focused AI performance and design.

stories.h: TOPC TXA2 mini PC workstation launches with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495, 192 GB LPDDR5X, $6,399
stories.s: TOPC introduced the TXA2 mini PC, powered by an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 APU, Radeon 8065S iGPU, 192 GB LPDDR5X‑8533 memory and up to 4 TB storage, priced from $6,399.

stories.h: XCENA showcases CXL-based MX1 memory solution for AI inference at OCP Global Summit
stories.s: XCENA demonstrated its CXL-based MX1 computational memory, including shared KV cache and near-data processing for vector search, partnering with SK hynix on hybrid memory architecture at the OCP Global Summit 2026.

stories.h: SP Industrial launches six new enterprise SSDs up to 15.3 TB with PCIe Gen 5
stories.s: SP Industrial announced six enterprise SSD models across E1.S, U.2, M.2 2280 and 2.5" SATA, offering capacities up to 15.3 TB, PCIe Gen 5 interfaces and up to 3 DWPD endurance.

stories.h: FADU unveils world's first File-Semantic SSD (FS-SSD) at OCP 2026
stories.s: Data‑center chipmaker FADU announced its File‑Semantic SSD, which processes files inside the drive via a Gen 6 controller, claiming up to 2.5× performance over Gen 5 and power use under 28 W active.

stories.h: Pulsar Feinmann F01 Noctua Edition gaming mouse reviewed with 42,000 CPI sensor
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews Pulsar's F01 Noctua Edition mouse featuring a 40 mm Noctua fan, 42,000 CPI XS‑2 sensor, 100 M click optical switches and a 500 mAh battery delivering 5‑10 hours of use.

stories.h: LattePanda Mu Ultra AI development kit launched with Intel Core Ultra 5 226V
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews the LattePanda Mu Ultra compute module featuring an Intel Core Ultra 5 226V, 16 GB LPDDR5X‑8533 memory and Arc 130V GPU, sold as a $643 kit with carrier board and cooler.

stories.h: Corsair Vanguard Air 99 Wireless keyboard reviewed
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews Corsair's Vanguard Air 99 Wireless keyboard, a 99% form‑factor, low‑profile mechanical keyboard with wired/wireless options and extra Stream Deck keys.

stories.h: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra reviewed with prices up to $3,699 and up to 128GB RAM
stories.s: Reviews note the Ultra’s powerful RTX Spark N1X chip, premium design and high price, with configurations from $2,599 to $3,699 and memory options up to 128GB, though AI performance is the main selling point.

stories.h: Thermaltake announces Dockpower FI detachable modular PSU for compact cases
stories.s: Thermaltake revealed the Dockpower FI, a modular desktop PSU with a separable connector section aimed at easier cable routing in compact and dual‑chamber cases.

stories.h: Red Magic unveils 5K MiniLED monitor with 5,184 zones, $856 price
stories.s: Red Magic announced a 5K MiniLED monitor featuring a 5,184-zone backlight, 180 Hz at 5K or 330 Hz at 2K, and a $856 price, slated for December 2026 release.

stories.h: IDC reports global PC shipments down 20.1% YoY in Q3 2026
stories.s: IDC data shows global PC shipments fell about 20.1% year‑over‑year in Q3 2026, pressured by rising DRAM and SSD costs and AI‑driven component demand.

stories.h: Googlebook OLED notebooks show gray blacks, firmware fix promised
stories.s: Google acknowledges that some OLED-equipped Googlebook laptops cannot display true black, showing a dark‑grey level, and plans a firmware update to correct the issue.

stories.h: ASUS lists white ROG Strix X870E-A Gaming WiFi7 Neo AM5 motherboard
stories.s: ASUS announced the ROG Strix X870E-A Gaming WiFi7 Neo, a white‑themed AM5 motherboard with X870E chipset, 16+2+2 power stages, DDR5, PCIe 5.0, Wi‑Fi 7 and USB4. Pricing varies by region.

stories.h: Intel Core 5 205H shows 19,390 PassMark multi-thread score
stories.s: PassMark lists the upcoming mobile Intel Core 5 205H with eight cores, twelve threads and a 19,390 multi-thread score, about 15.7% higher than the i5-13420H.

stories.h: SK hynix unveils H-TPU SSD controller architecture with 100+ specialized cores
stories.s: SK hynix presented the H-TPU, a new SSD controller architecture using over 100 small specialized cores that claim 2.5% power of a conventional CPU core, targeting enterprise PCIe 6.0 drives.

stories.h: ViewSonic launches 26.5" 4K 120Hz QD-OLED monitor VG2782Z-4K in China for $786
stories.s: ViewSonic introduced the VG2782Z-4K, a 26.5-inch QD-OLED monitor with 3840×2160 resolution, 120 Hz refresh, 140 W USB‑C charging and integrated KVM, priced at CNY 5,262 (~$786) in China.

stories.h: MSI launches limited MSI GeForce RTX 5080 16G COD MW4 EDITION OC graphics card
stories.s: MSI announced a limited-edition RTX 5080 16GB graphics card themed after Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, featuring a yellow‑painted TRIO FROZR 4 cooler and a transparent backplate, with sales starting Oct 23, 2026 in selected countries.

stories.h: Colorful unveils iGame X870E ULTRA-S AM5 motherboard with 192GB DDR5-6600 support
stories.s: Colorful announced the iGame X870E ULTRA-S motherboard for AMD AM5, claiming up to 192GB DDR5-6600 memory at CL28, 16 PCIe Gen6/CXL Gen3 MCIO interfaces and PCIe 5.0 graphics support, with no price or availability yet.

stories.h: GlobalFoundries unveils 7nm-class FD‑SOI FDX Fusion node
stories.s: GlobalFoundries announced its new 7nm-class FD‑SOI process, FDX Fusion, targeting automotive, edge AI and industrial markets, with production slated for Dresden in 2028 and demo silicon in early 2027.

stories.h: Nvidia RTX Spark Superchip tested in Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra with 20 CPU cores, 6144 CUDA cores, 128GB LPDDR5X-9400 RAM
stories.s: Tom's Hardware evaluated the RTX Spark platform on a Surface Laptop Ultra, noting it outperformed an M5 Max MacBook Pro in local AI benchmarks, completing tasks 25% faster on the Qwen 3.8 27B model.

stories.h: Elon Musk criticizes memory makers for 'extortionate' pricing, praises Micron's approach
stories.s: Elon Musk called out Samsung and SK hynix for high memory prices, highlighting Micron's 81% GAAP gross margin in Q4 FY2026, amid ongoing DRAM and HBM shortages.

stories.h: Two killed, one seriously hurt in explosion at Intel's Kiryat Gat plant
stories.s: An explosion suspected to be caused by a gas cylinder malfunction at Intel's Fab 28 in Kiryat Gat, Israel, killed two workers and injured another seriously, raising concerns about production impacts.

stories.h: Qualcomm, GFiber and Gemtek unveil Wi‑Fi 8 Premium Gateway for 20 Gig customers
stories.s: Qualcomm's Dragonwing NPro A8 Elite Platform will power GFiber's Wi‑Fi 8 Premium Gateway, built by Gemtek, for subscribers of GFiber's 20 Gig service, with rollout expected in 2027.

stories.h: SK hynix unveils H-TPU custom cores for SSD controllers to cut power use
stories.s: SK hynix announced its H-TPU, a tiny custom CPU core for SSD controllers that uses about 2.5% of a general‑purpose core's power and 4% of its area, aiming to offload repetitive I/O tasks as drive speeds increase.

stories.h: Intel outlines EMIB and Foveros packaging roadmap through 2030
stories.s: Intel detailed its future EMIB and Foveros advanced packaging plans, targeting finer bump pitches down to 25 µm, larger SiP sizes up to 12 reticles and glass-core substrates by 2030.

stories.h: Newegg bundles AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D PC build for $1,165.99, RAM effectively $151
stories.s: Newegg offers a combo of AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU, Gigabyte X870E Elite WiFi7 motherboard, 32 GB DDR5‑6000 RAM, 2 TB NV5000 SSD, Cooler Master AIO and a game for $1,165.99, saving 23% off list price.

stories.h: Apple uses idle Macs as a virtual GPU cloud called “Minions”
stories.s: Apple researchers described “Minions,” a system that pools idle Macs’ Apple Silicon GPUs to run AI inference jobs, cutting queue times from hours to minutes, per an arXiv paper.

stories.h: Ledger reports $93 million crypto wallet supply‑chain hack, reviews sales and anti‑tamper policies
stories.s: Ledger confirmed a physical implant in wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that stole recovery phrases, causing $93 million losses, and is reviewing its sales, vendor verification and anti‑tamper measures.

stories.h: Nvidia RTX 50-series GPU prices in Japan up to 41.1% higher than US Amazon listings
stories.s: Tom's Hardware reports Japanese retail prices for Nvidia RTX 5080‑5060 Ti GPUs are 5.66%‑41.10% above US Amazon pre‑tax prices, reflecting supply pressure from AI demand and a planned RTX 5090 production halt.

stories.h: 32GB DDR5-6000 RAM-in qiyməti 450 dollara çatıb, keçən ildən bəri 500%-dən çox artıb
stories.s: Tom's Hardware qeyd edir ki, ən ucuz 32GB DDR5-6000 dəsti indi 449,97 dollar dəyərindədir. Bu, keçən ildən bəri qiymətin 500%-dən çox artmasını əks etdirir və III rübdə PC çatdırılmalarının 20% azalmasına töhfə verir.
stories.he: 32GB DDR5‑6000 RAM price hits $450, up over 500% since last year

stories.h: Framework Laptop 12 review shows higher price despite repairability
stories.s: Tom's Hardware finds the Framework Laptop 12 highly portable and repairable but priced $1,491 fully configured, about $200‑$300 above rivals, with a middling 1080p60 display and poor webcam.

stories.h: CXMT plans to launch first 4F² DDR5 RDIMM server memory by year-end
stories.s: CXMT president Cao Kanyu announced the company will release its first 4F² DRAM server DDR5 RDIMM by the end of 2026, using a vertical transistor design that reduces cell footprint by about one-third.

stories.h: Alienware AW3226Q 32" 4K OLED monitor reviewed at $699
stories.s: Tom's Hardware and PCWorld reviewed the Alienware AW3226Q 32-inch 4K OLED monitor, noting its bright TRS‑OLED panel, 165 Hz refresh, Dolby Vision support and solid value at $699, while citing limited USB‑C docking and lack of speakers.

stories.h: NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB price tops $1,200 in Japan
stories.s: Retail listings show the RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB now costs ¥139,800 (~$882) and the RTX 5080 16 GB ¥295,801 (~$1,867), representing up to 144% above MSRP due to soaring memory prices.

stories.h: GlobalFoundries to operate two new $10 B semiconductor fabs in Malta, NY
stories.s: GlobalFoundries will run two 300 mm fabs in Malta, New York, funded by a U.S.-Japan initiative totalling up to $21 billion, with production slated for 2029 and full capacity by 2033.

stories.h: Microsoft launches Xbox Nano Controller for $49.99
stories.s: Microsoft announced the pocket-sized Xbox Nano Controller, measuring just over five inches, weighing 3.5 ounces, and priced at $49.99, with pre‑orders open and launch on November 4 in 36 markets.

stories.h: Tuxedo launches Stellaris 16 Gen 8 laptop with Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus and RTX 5070‑5090 options
stories.s: Tuxedo Computers introduced the Stellaris 16 Gen 8, a 16‑inch desktop‑replacement laptop featuring optional liquid cooling, Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus CPUs and NVIDIA RTX 5070‑5090 GPUs, starting at €2,350.

stories.h: StarTech launches Dual-Monitor USB‑C Smart Dock with fleet management software
stories.s: StarTech's new Dual‑Monitor USB‑C Smart Dock (194N‑USBC‑SmartDock) adds remote fleet management, 4K 60 Hz dual displays, 96 W charging and a dedicated Dock Manager software for IT teams.

stories.h: Rambus unveils power‑management IC for upcoming LPDDR6 SOCAMM2 memory modules
stories.s: Rambus announced a new Power Management IC designed for low‑power, high‑performance LPDDR6 SOCAMM2 server memory modules, now sampling to lead customers.

stories.h: Cooler Master GPU Shield price drops to €29.99 in EU, warranty cut to two years
stories.s: Cooler Master reduced the EU price of its GPU Shield adaptor cable to €29.99 and shortened the warranty to two years, down from three years in the US and China.

stories.h: Lenovo raises Legion Go 2 price to $3,081.99
stories.s: Lenovo increased the price of the Legion Go 2 handheld with 32 GB RAM and 2 TB storage from $2,849 to $3,081.99, an $233 (8%) hike, while other Legion Go models also saw price jumps.

stories.h: NVIDIA 20 nüvəli Grace CPU və 6 144 nüvəli Blackwell iGPU ilə RTX Spark superçipini təqdim etdi
stories.s: NVIDIA RTX Spark superçipini elan edib. Çip 20 nüvəli Grace CPU və 6 144 CUDA nüvəli GeForce RTX Blackwell iGPU ilə təchiz olunub, DLSS 5 dəstəyi və anti-cheat uyğunluğu təqdim edir. RTX Spark 16 oktyabr tarixində Windows 11 kompüterləri üçün satışa çıxarılacaq.
stories.he: NVIDIA unveils RTX Spark superchip with 20-core Grace CPU and 6,144‑core Blackwell iGPU

stories.h: be quiet! launches Dark Power Pro 14 IO 1600W flagship PSU
stories.s: be quiet! unveiled its new Dark Power Pro 14 IO 1600W power supply, featuring ATX 3.1 compliance, 80 Plus Titanium efficiency, USB‑C telemetry and dual 12V‑2x6 connectors.

stories.h: Team Group releases T-Force XTREEM DDR5-6400 32 GB kit for gamers
stories.s: TechPowerUp reviews Team Group's T-Force XTREEM DDR5-6400 32 GB (2×16 GB) memory kit, featuring 32-39-39-84 timings at 1.35 V and targeting AMD gamers.

stories.h: NZXT releases H6 RGB+ full‑tower case with 7 fans and wrap‑around glass
stories.s: NZXT's 2026 H6 RGB+ full‑tower case adds a single‑piece wrap‑around glass panel, rear motherboard support and boosts fan count from four to seven, weighing 9.3 kg and measuring 420 × 292 × 448 mm.

stories.h: Gigabyte launches X870 Aorus Infinity motherboard at $800
stories.s: Gigabyte's new X870 Aorus Infinity motherboard, an updated Tachyon model, uses the AMD X870 chipset, supports DDR5-11400, and retails for $800, $50 above the Apex launch price.

stories.h: RTX 5090 price spikes to $5,000 in North America
stories.s: The RTX 5090, originally launched at $1,999, now costs at least $5,000 in North America according to price tracking, reflecting a significant market price increase.

stories.h: Mozilla releases Firefox 158 fixing 77 security flaws, adds AI form‑filling
stories.s: Firefox 158 launched for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, introducing AI‑powered Smart Windows for form filling, JPEG XL support, and patches 77 security flaws including 30 high‑risk bugs.

stories.h: Microsoft releases Windows 11 update KB5127648 fixing mouse input stutter in games
stories.s: Microsoft confirmed a Windows 11 bug that could cause mouse input to stutter in some games and fixed it in the October 2026 update KB5127648 for builds 24H2, 25H2 and 26H2.

stories.h: Microsoft fixes record 1,416 security flaws in October 2026 Patch Tuesday
stories.s: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday update addressed 1,416 vulnerabilities, including 85 critical flaws and 67 remote code execution issues, urging immediate installation.

stories.h: Alienware launches 27" QD-OLED gaming monitor AW2726DM for $350
stories.s: Alienware’s AW2726DM 27-inch 1440p QD-OLED monitor offers a 240Hz refresh rate and OLED quality at an everyday price of $350, though it lacks brightness, USB hub and full‑speed HDMI.

stories.h: HP EliteBook 6 G1q with Snapdragon X1 Plus gets mainline Linux support patches
stories.s: HP posted mainline kernel patches enabling full functionality of the EliteBook 6 G1q with Snapdragon X1P42100, covering keyboard, touchpad, touchscreen, USB, Ethernet, HDMI, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, audio, camera and fingerprint reader.

stories.h: Mesa 26.3 Rusticl driver benchmarked against AMD ROCm 10 on Ryzen AI Max+ 395
stories.s: Phoronix benchmarked the open-source Rusticl OpenCL driver in Mesa 26.3 against AMD's ROCm 10 driver on the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 "Strix Halo" platform, noting Rusticl supports OpenCL 3.1 while ROCm offers OpenCL 2.1.

stories.h: Intel yeni süni intellekt akseleratoru GPU D-Seriyasının (Crescent Island) adını və texniki xüsusiyyətlərini açıqladı
stories.s: Intel Crescent Island süni intellekt akseleratoru ilə təchiz olunmuş GPU D-Seriyasını təqdim etdi. Hava soyutmalı PCIe kartında 1.3 PFLOPS FP8, 1.5 TB/s yaddaş zolağı genişliyi, 350 W TDP və 480 GB-ə qədər LPDDR5X yaddaş təklif olunur.
stories.he: Intel names and specs its new AI accelerator GPU D-Series (Crescent Island)

stories.h: HP OmniBook Ultra 16 AI notebook announced with NVIDIA RTX Spark, 20‑core Grace CPU and up to 128 GB unified memory
stories.s: HP unveiled the OmniBook Ultra 16 AI PC, a 16‑inch laptop featuring a 20‑core NVIDIA Grace CPU, Blackwell‑derived RTX GPU with 6,144 CUDA cores, up to 128 GB unified memory and a starting price of approx. $3,922, with orders beginning 29 Oct 2026.

stories.h: ASUS announces ROG Strix OLED XG27AQDMG Gen2 26.5" QHD 240Hz monitor
stories.s: ASUS will release the 26.5-inch ROG Strix OLED XG27AQDMG Gen2 gaming monitor with a 2560×1440 panel, 240Hz refresh rate and TrueBlack Glossy coating, arriving in Japan on 16 October 2026; price is not yet disclosed.

stories.h: ASUS announces ROG Strix XG27ACNS 27" monitor with up to 920Hz refresh
stories.s: ASUS unveiled the ROG Strix XG27ACNS, a 27-inch gaming monitor offering 2560×1440 at up to 475Hz, 1920×1080 at up to 620Hz, and 1280×720 at up to 920Hz, with ELMB‑Sync technology; price and release date are not yet disclosed.

stories.h: ADATA XPG MARS 980 BLADE SSD launches with up to 14,000 MB/s PCIe 5.0 read
stories.s: ADATA’s XPG MARS 980 BLADE PCIe 5.0 SSD, using a Silicon Motion SM2508 6nm controller, offers up to 14,000 MB/s sequential read, 10,000 MB/s write and 1,600,000 IOPS 4K random read, with a five‑year replacement‑first warranty.

stories.h: KIOXIA launches CM9-DLC enterprise SSD with liquid‑cooling, up to 32TB
stories.s: KIOXIA announced the CM9-DLC, an EDSFF E3.S PCIe 5.0 SSD with direct cold‑plate liquid cooling, dual‑port support and capacities up to 32 TB, delivering up to 14.8 GB/s read and 11 GB/s write speeds.

stories.h: Thermaltake launches OB360 360mm AIO cooler with unified fan frame
stories.s: Thermaltake's new OB360 AIO liquid cooler is rated for up to 360W TDP, uses a single 360mm fan frame, runs 500‑2000RPM (53.9CFM, 2.36mmH2O) and peaks at 32.3dB(A). It supports LGA1851, LGA1700, LGA115x, AM4 and AM5 sockets.

stories.h: Valve discontinues Index VR headset, discounts remaining stock to £367
stories.s: Valve announced the end of production for the Index headset, clearing out remaining units at £367 for the headset, £111 for controllers and £95 for the tether cable as it shifts focus to the new Steam Frame standalone VR device.

stories.h: ID‑Cooling launches Frozn A610 XL air cooler with 250W rating and 17mm fan
stories.s: ID‑Cooling unveiled the Frozn A610 XL at Computex 2026, a single‑tower air cooler rated for 250W that uses a slim 17mm AF‑12017 fan to maintain RAM clearance across AMD AM4/AM5 and Intel LGA115x, LGA1200, LGA1700, LGA1851 sockets.

stories.h: Sapphire launches Valor Mortis themed RX 9070 XT NITRO+ edition
stories.s: Sapphire unveiled a limited‑edition NITRO+ Radeon RX 9070 XT Valor Mortis Edition with custom backplate, shroud and ARGB, retaining the same RDNA 4 performance as the standard model, available through selected retailers later in October 2026.

stories.h: SteelSeries launches Rival 8K mouse with Ultra‑Wideband 8000Hz wireless
stories.s: SteelSeries introduced the Rival 8K mouse featuring Ultra‑Wideband wireless and true 8000Hz polling, priced at £169.99 for full‑size and mini versions, available globally.

stories.h: NVIDIA launches faster DLSS 5 model for RTX Spark laptops
stories.s: NVIDIA's new DLSS 5, using 3D‑Guided Neural Rendering, boosts frame rates up to 1.4x in NBA 2K27 Season 2 and will roll out to games like Hogwarts Legacy in November and RTX Spark laptops shipping Oct 16.

stories.h: PCSpecialist Cruiser Gallant prebuilt reviewed at £2599 with Ryzen 7 9850X3D and RX 9070 XT
stories.s: KitGuru reviews the PCSpecialist Cruiser Gallant prebuilt featuring an AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D, Radeon RX 9070 XT, 32 GB DDR5 and a £2599 price, noting strong performance but loud default fan curve.

stories.h: Marvell launches Structera X 3406 and 3506 CXL memory expanders with up to 9TB capacity
stories.s: Marvell announced second‑gen Structera X CXL expanders (3406 and 3506) supporting CXL 3.2, PCIe 6.0, six downstream channels and up to 9TB (DDR4) or 6TB (DDR5) memory, with LZ4 compression up to 250GB/s.

stories.h: Colorful Battle-AX BA26M-G Micro-ATX case launches in China for approx. $37
stories.s: The Battle-AX BA26M-G case is now available at Chinese retailers for CNY 249 (about $37), offering a dual‑glass design, 390mm GPU clearance and support for 360mm radiators.

stories.h: Bosgame E7 Mini PC launches with Intel Core 3 100U for €449
stories.s: Bosgame introduced the E7 mini PC featuring a 6‑core Intel Core 3 100U processor, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD and dual RJ‑45 ports, priced at €449.

stories.h: Xiaomi launches REDMI A27U 2027 27" 4K 75Hz monitor in China for about $179
stories.s: Xiaomi has started selling the REDMI A27U 2027 27-inch 4K IPS monitor in China at CNY 1,199 (≈$179), featuring 75Hz refresh, 400 nits brightness, 1,500:1 contrast and an adjustable stand.

stories.h: Thermalright launches Frozen Horizon 240 Digital AIO cooler priced at approx. $51
stories.s: Thermalright introduced the Frozen Horizon 240 Digital, a 240mm AIO liquid CPU cooler with a rotating digital pump display, priced at CNY 339 (~$51) in China and includes two TL‑Q12 fans.

stories.h: AOC launches Q27U4D 27" QD-OLED monitor with 96W USB‑C charging and KVM
stories.s: AOC introduced the Q27U4D, a 27‑inch QD‑OLED panel at 2560×1440 @ 144 Hz, priced at CNY 2,999 (~$448) with subsidies to CNY 2,706.55 (~$404), featuring 96 W USB‑C power delivery, KVM switch and 4 × 10 Gbps USB hub.

stories.h: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra 128GB model sells out in US store
stories.s: Microsoft's top‑spec Surface Laptop Ultra with 128GB unified memory and 1TB SSD, priced at $5,899.99, is now unavailable in the United States store, while lower‑memory versions remain on sale.

stories.h: Microsoft warns Windows 10/11 PCs may lose update access after May/June 2027
stories.s: Microsoft says Windows 10 Enterprise 2019 LTSC, Windows Server 2019 and 2016 must get certificate updates before May 17, 2027, or lose Windows Update connectivity; other Windows 10/11 versions need updates by June 19, 2027.

stories.h: HKC launches G7W White Edition 27" QHD 240Hz monitor priced around $158
stories.s: HKC released a white‑edition G7W 27‑inch QHD 240Hz Fast IPS gaming monitor in China, listed at CNY 1,054 (≈$158), with native 200Hz and overclocked 240Hz support.

stories.h: Titan Army launches 31.5" P326MV Ultra dual-mode 4K 200Hz/1080p 400Hz monitor at $581
stories.s: Titan Army's new 31.5-inch P326MV Ultra offers 3840×2160 at 200Hz or 1920×1080 at 400Hz, 2,304 Mini LED zones, 1ms GtG, and launches in China for CNY 3,888 (~$581).

stories.h: Gigabyte adds BIOS support for upcoming Intel LGA1700 CPUs on B760 and H610 boards
stories.s: Gigabyte released BIOS updates for its entire B760 and H610 motherboard ranges to support a future Intel LGA1700 processor generation expected in early 2027, extending the socket's lifespan.

stories.h: OneXPlayer X2 Air handheld PC launches in Japan for approx. $1,634
stories.s: One-Netbook released the OneXPlayer X2 Air in Japan, featuring an Intel Core Ultra 7 258V with Arc 140V graphics, 32 GB LPDDR5X‑8533 RAM, 1 TB SSD and a 10.95‑inch 2560×1600 touchscreen, priced at ¥258,000 (~$1,634).

stories.h: IDC reports global PC shipments fell 20.1% YoY in Q3 2026
stories.s: IDC's preliminary data shows worldwide PC shipments dropped to 62.7 million units in Q3 2026, a 20.1% YoY decline and 9.1% below Q2, with HP, Dell and Lenovo seeing the biggest falls.

stories.h: Gigabyte launches GO27Q32 27" QHD 320Hz QD-OLED monitor
stories.s: Gigabyte unveiled the GO27Q32, a 27-inch QHD gaming monitor with a 320Hz QD-OLED panel, 0.03ms response, 300 nits SDR and 1300 nits HDR brightness, and Nvidia G‑Sync Compatible/AMD FreeSync Premium support.

stories.h: Singularity Computers launches Portal ITX wall‑mount water‑cooling case for $299
stories.s: Singularity Computers introduced the Portal ITX wall‑mount case, an open‑frame Mini‑ITX chassis with integrated distribution plate, reservoir and D5 pump top, supporting dual 240mm or 280mm radiators.

stories.h: Razer launches Basilisk V4 gaming mouse lineup and Mouse Dock V2 Pro
stories.s: Razer unveiled the Basilisk V4 Pro and HyperSpeed mice with up to 50,000 DPI sensors, 200‑275 hour battery life, and a new Mouse Dock V2 Pro wireless charger; prices start at £109.00/$109.99/€119.99 for the Pro model.

stories.h: Gigabyte Aorus Master 16 gaming laptop launches with Ryzen 9 9955HX3D and RTX 5090
stories.s: Gigabyte unveiled the AORUS MASTER 16, featuring a Ryzen 9 9955HX3D 16‑core CPU, GeForce RTX 5090 mobile GPU (up to 175 W), 32 GB DDR5, 2 TB NVMe, 99 Wh battery and 2.5K 240 Hz OLED display, priced from $4,899.

stories.h: PCWorld names MSI MPG 272URX best gaming monitor
stories.s: PCWorld's 2026 roundup lists the MSI MPG 272URX QD‑OLED as the top gaming monitor, highlighting its 26.5‑inch 4K panel, 240 Hz refresh rate and $1,099.99 price.

stories.h: Linux 7.4 to add Device Tree support for three Snapdragon X2 Elite laptops
stories.s: The upcoming Linux 7.4 merge window will include DT patches for the ASUS Zenbook A14 UX3407NA, Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x Gen11, and HP EliteBook X G2q 14 AI, enabling initial boot support for Snapdragon X2 Elite SoCs.

stories.h: Intel posts v2 Linux driver patches for HDMI 2.1 FRL on Meteor Lake and newer
stories.s: Intel engineer Ankit Nautiyal released second‑iteration patches adding HDMI 2.1 Fixed Rate Link support, pipe joiner, and audio prune, now testing 4K@120 on Panther Lake, but full mainline merge expected not before 2027.

stories.h: Linux kernel adds workaround for AMD TLBI erratum #1718
stories.s: Linux 7.3-rc7 includes a software fix forcing TLBSYNC to mitigate AMD TLBI erratum #1718, which can cause TLB invalidation failures on older microcode versions; backports will follow for prior kernels.

stories.h: Microsoft adds para-virtualized IOMMU driver for Hyper-V to Linux kernel
stories.s: Microsoft contributed a para-virtualized IOMMU driver (hv-iommu-guest) for Hyper-V, enabling in‑kernel DMA protection and device assignment for Linux guests, supporting Intel VT‑d and AMD IOMMU.

stories.h: AMD PerfOpt feature in Linux 7.4 boosts prior‑gen Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U AI performance up to 23%
stories.s: Benchmarks on a Lenovo ThinkPad P14s Gen 4 with Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U show AMD's new PerfOpt IOMMU optimization in Linux 7.4 can improve AI workloads by 18–23% when enabled.

stories.h: AMD details EPYC 8005 Sorano SKU lineup and performance specs
stories.s: ServeTheHome outlines the 7 SKUs of AMD's EPYC 8005 Sorano server CPUs, covering core counts from 8 to 84, 4.5 GHz max turbo, DDR5, PCIe Gen5 and power/TDP details.

stories.h: SPECviewperf 15.0.1 Linux Edition released with Arm AArch64 support
stories.s: SPECviewperf 15.0.1 Linux Edition adds a new GUI, snap‑in workloads and native support for Arm AArch64, marking the first Linux benchmark on Arm‑based systems.

stories.h: GMKtec launches EVO-X3 mini‑PC with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 128GB LPDDR5X
stories.s: The new EVO‑X3 mini‑PC features an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (16C/32T, 5.1GHz), 128GB LPDDR5X‑8000 memory, Radeon 8060S iGPU and an OCuLink port for external PCIe devices.

stories.h: Microsoft to stop Windows Update on PCs missing certificate rotation by May 17/June 19 2027
stories.s: Microsoft will replace Windows Update certificates; PCs that don't receive the July 2026 or later updates will lose access to Windows Update after the current certificates expire on May 17 and June 19 2027.

stories.h: AMD Raises GDDR6 Memory Prices for Board Partners
stories.s: AMD has reportedly increased the price of GDDR6 memory supplied to its AIB partners effective Oct 1, likely pushing up retail GPU prices, especially in China where Radeon cards already saw price hikes.

stories.h: NVIDIA Stops GB202 Chip Allocation to RTX 5090, Shifts to Workstation GPUs
stories.s: NVIDIA is reportedly ending RTX 5090 production, redirecting its GB202 silicon to RTX Pro workstation cards, while an RTX 5080 24 GB will become the top GeForce model; the 5090 launched at $1,999 and now sells for up to €5,000.

stories.h: AOC launches U27G4Z 27" dual-mode 4K/1080p gaming monitor with 240 Hz/480 Hz refresh rates
stories.s: AOC unveiled the 27‑inch U27G4Z in China, featuring a Fast IPS panel that runs at 240 Hz 4K or 480 Hz 1080p, 1 ms GtG, 0.3 ms MPRT, HDR400, and NVIDIA G‑SYNC compatibility, but pricing and global availability are not announced yet.

stories.h: Counterfeit RTX 4090 with fake die and memory sold for $350 in Russia
stories.s: A Russian GPU repair specialist discovered a fake RTX 4090 PCB with a dummy GPU die and GDDR6 chips masquerading as GDDR6X, sold for about $350. The scam involved detailed counterfeit labeling and BGA soldering.

stories.h: Modder shows GPU repositioning can cut hotspot temps by up to 19°C
stories.s: Enthusiast TrashBench repositioned an RTX 3080 in a desktop, achieving a 19°C reduction in GPU hotspot temperature and up to 3.3°C cooler CPU in certain configs.

stories.h: SanDisk NAS 800 1.92TB SSD reviewed with up to 14,900 MB/s read and 13,200 MB/s write
stories.s: Tom's Hardware reviewed the SanDisk NAS 800 series, noting its high endurance (3,500 TBW for 1.92 TB), PCIe 5.0 x4 performance up to 14,900 MB/s read and 13,200 MB/s write, and a premium price of $699.99.

stories.h: Cryptomining malware PoeLLM infects over 3,400 servers using poem‑based C2 addresses
stories.s: Lumen's Black Lotus Labs report that PoeLLM cryptomining malware has compromised more than 3,400 servers, targeting AI/LLM services like LiteLLM and Ollama via a poem‑encoded C2 mechanism.

stories.h: Super Micro broker pleads guilty to smuggling Nvidia AI chips to China
stories.s: Ting-Wei “Willy” Sun pleaded guilty to conspiring with Super Micro co‑founder Yih‑Shyan “Wally” Liaw and sales manager Ruei‑Tsang “Steven” Chang to divert Nvidia AI chips to China, using fake paperwork and altered server shells.

stories.h: Gigabyte GO27Q24G 27" OLED monitor launches at $350 with 240 Hz QHD
stories.s: Tom's Hardware reviews the Gigabyte GO27Q24G, a 27‑inch QHD 240 Hz OLED gaming monitor priced at $350, noting its high brightness, 10‑bit color and solid build despite missing USB ports and speakers.

stories.h: AMD unveils Helion rack design supporting up to 32,768 Zen 6 cores
stories.s: AMD announced the Helion reference rack, a 21‑inch OCP‑compliant design that can house up to 128 EPYC 9996 CPUs for a total of 32,768 Zen 6 cores, with options for liquid cooling and hybrid GPU configurations.
